map.RC4 / ARC4 加密解密 使用指南: RC4 / ARC4 Encrypt and Decrypt User Guide
map.RC4 以密钥调度生成伪随机流与明文异或；因偏弱偏（前若干字节有偏）已被弃用。…: RC4 generates a pseudo-random keystream from the key schedule and XORs it with the plaintext; it is deprecated because it is weak and biased (the first several bytes carry bias).
map.RC4 / ARC4 流密码加解密（加密与解密是同一操作）: RC4 / ARC4 stream cipher encryption and decryption (encryption and decryption are the same operation)
map.可选 drop768 / drop1024 / drop2048，丢弃前若干字节: Optional drop768 / drop1024 / drop2048, discarding the first N output bytes to mitigate bias
map.仅用于兼容历史协议，新系统不应采用: For legacy protocol compatibility only; new systems should not adopt it
map.轻量流密码，仅用于兼容历史协议。: A lightweight stream cipher, used only for compatibility with legacy protocols.
map.维护老协议兼容：某些遗留系统仍在用 RC4，需要按同样算法加解密才能对接——但新: Keeping legacy protocol compatibility: some leftover systems still use RC4 and need the same algorithm to interoperate, but new systems must never adopt it again.
map.确认对方确实用 RC4（如遗留协议），否则改用 AES: Confirm that the peer really uses RC4 (such as a legacy protocol), otherwise switch to AES
map.选择变体：若对方实现丢弃前 N 字节，这里选对应的 drop 值才能对上: Choose the variant: if the peer implementation discards the first N bytes, pick the matching drop value here
map.输入密钥：RC4 密钥长度可变，但必须与对方完全相同（按字节）: Enter the key: the RC4 key length is variable, but it must be exactly the same as the peer's (byte for byte)
map.填入明文或密文，输出格式选 Base64 或十六进制: Enter plaintext or ciphertext and choose Base64 or hexadecimal output
map.结果拿去与对方实现比对；不一致时先查变体与密钥编码（UTF-8 还是 Latin: Take the result and compare it with the peer's implementation; if they differ, first check the variants and the key encoding (UTF-8 or Latin-1).
map.新系统不建议，优先 AES-GCM/ChaCha20: Not recommended for new systems; prefer AES-GCM/ChaCha20
map.新系统不建议，优先 AES-GCM/ChaCha20。: Not recommended for new systems; prefer AES-GCM/ChaCha20.
map.RC4 具体有什么问题？: What Exactly Is Wrong With RC4?
map.三点：一是密钥调度存在偏差，密文前若干字节的统计特性会泄露密钥信息（Fluhre: Three problems: first, the key schedule is biased, so the statistical properties of the first ciphertext bytes leak key information (the Fluhrer-Mantin-Shamir attack, once used to break WEP); second, many known invariants and weak keys; third, no IV usage discipline, so reusing a keystream allows decryption. RFC 7465 explicitly forbids RC4 in TLS.
